questions.text: During causal autoregressive decoding with fixed model weights, what does the KV cache let the model reuse?

options.A: The final next-token probabilities, unchanged for all subsequent tokens.
options.B: Previously computed key and value vectors for the prefix at each layer.
options.C: The new token’s query vector before the new token is known.

questions.explanation: Prefix keys and values remain valid under causal attention and can be reused instead of recomputing them for each new token.
